scope: Official source authentication review, isolated login help parsing, and synthetic current-adapter red test only. No authenticate/session/new/prompt or account reads.

sourceEvidence.meaning: cached_token can refresh and fall through if token disappeared/expired/legacy; it is not a guaranteed read-only no-login check.
grok.com/oidc invoke the full login chain, including headless branch.
Unpinned cached fallback can choose grok.com and replace headless metadata with use_oauth:true.
Pinned preferred_method prevents cached-token fallback; oidc error asks user to run grok login.
Full chain cache/refresh/provider/interactive, not an authentication-status probe.
Valid compatible cache can return; missing cache continues through refresh/external provider/browser/device login.
headless changes plumbing; it does not assert no-interactive-login.
Official config supports auth.preferred_method, source evidence only; no user profile was inspected/edited.
Official auth may be relocated by GROK_AUTH_PATH; do not inherit this override into an explicitly isolated profile.
session/new resolves workspace and prepares session before later auth_method_id gate; not a side-effect-free auth probe.
Source auth-required gate is keyed on absence of selected auth_method_id. Not a live provider-token-validity proof. Unexecuted in this work.
Official source already tests fresh user advertises grok.com only; advertisement is expected, not evidence of incompatible ACP protocol.

findings.blankOfficialProfile: Actual protocol1 response advertises grok.com only/defaultAuthMethodId null. Correct state is authentication required, never ready.
findings.currentAdapterSafeBoundary: Current adapter correctly refuses before authenticate when cached_token absent, but reports generic failed and marks default unknown outcome despite no accepted work.
findings.existingPrivateProfile: Source advertises cached_token when compatible session cache exists (or refresh succeeds) in the explicit official profile. Host must pass the user-authorized dedicated profile path without reading/copying credentials; no local profile exists in these probes.
findings.grokComIsNotCacheOnly: It may return cache but can start provider/browser/device flow if unavailable; headless=true is not no-login authorization.
findings.cachedTokenRace: Token can disappear after initialize; unpinned source cached_token falls through to another auth method. Never describe it as guaranteed no interactive login.
findings.sessionNew: Source-inferred auth_required when no auth_method_id. This RPC was not executed and is not a safe auth-status probe.

minimumProposedChanges.change: Keep strict protocol1 validation and never select grok.com/oidc/xai.api_key automatically. For absent cached_token retain compatible error code ACP_CACHED_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE but add details.authenticationRequired=true and outcomeUnknown=false only for this before-any-accepted-work generation. Do not weaken remote-error/protocol/timeout unknown-outcome handling.

Map the explicit pre-work missing-auth error to runtime state authentication_required; retain saved user message and clear actionable login-required explanation. No runtime_ready event, no successful answer/model metric, no app tools admission.

Use actual help-verified standalone argv --no-auto-update agent --no-leader stdio. A dedicated existing private official profile must be explicitly selected by user; do not inspect/copy/merge host account caches or inherit GROK_AUTH/GROK_AUTH_PATH/API-key/helper overrides.

minimumProposedChanges.owner: future profile setup; requires explicit user authorization before real authentication
minimumProposedChanges.change: A new owned session-based profile may use official [auth] preferred_method="oidc" to stop cached-token fallback, after exact binary/config behavior is separately validated. Do not overwrite an existing user profile. Treat inability to enforce no-fallback as an unresolved login side-effect risk; do not call authenticate/grok.com as a workaround.

focusedTests.classification: 3 current safety controls pass; 1 explicitly PROPOSED missing-auth classification test is red because authenticationRequired/outcomeUnknown metadata is absent. Synthetic replay only; no real authenticate was invoked.
